name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Input.of_pres
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {bs : List.{0} Bool} {lo : Nat} {W : List.{0} Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Input m bs →
    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Pres m m' lo W →
      LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN 1) (List.length.{0} bs)) lo →
        (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} W x → LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN) →
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Input m' bs

source.code:
theorem Input.of_pres {m m' : Mem} {bs : List Bool} {lo : ℕ} {W : List ℕ}
    (h : Input m bs) (hp : Pres m m' lo W) (hlo : IN + 1 + bs.length ≤ lo)
    (hW : ∀ x, x ∈ W → x < IN) : Input m' bs := by
  refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · rw [hp IN (by omega) (fun hm => by have := hW IN hm; omega), h.1]
  · rw [hp (IN + 1 + i) (by omega) (fun hm => by have := hW _ hm; omega), h.2 i hi]
